Voice compatibility & practice notes

Voice requires a browser with on-device Web Speech recognition and an installed English (US) language pack. Some browsers, including many mobile browsers, do not expose this feature. We check your browser before enabling voice; there is no cloud speech fallback. Keyboard mode works without speech support. Your browser may need an initial language-pack download. Microphone permission is requested when you start voice practice.

Use headphones, speak the complete call sign in one phrase, and keep this page in the foreground. These are randomly generated US-style practice call signs, not a registry of assigned stations. Settings apply to the next playback. Revealing a call sign counts as a miss.
